newsitem.title: POLAND: ELEKTRIM BUYS CONSTRUCTION FIRM MEGADEX.
newsitem.headline: ELEKTRIM BUYS CONSTRUCTION FIRM MEGADEX.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading conglomerate Elektrim SA paid 16.3 million zlotys to the state treasury for a 75-percent stake in construction company Megadex SA, the treasury ministry said on Wednesday.

It said in a statement that under the agreement signed with the treasury ministry on Wedenesday Elektrim was obliged to increase the capital of Warsaw-based Megadex by 40 million zlotys within the next 18 months.
Elektrim also pledged to maintain Megadex' employment at the current level for 24 months and not to allow workers' wages fall in real terms. The statement included no further details.
Megadex specialised in building industrial facilities, notably in the energy sector, both in Poland and abraod.
